text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! A new record time! Let's do one 
more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, don't go thinking I'll poop out 
after just this! I'm gonna beat my record 
again next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to beat all my rivals, I just 
have to train, train, and train like 
crazy!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've got a dependable partner by my 
side! Right, Trainy?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you being here, I can devote 
myself to training without a single worry.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed, 
sure. But that's what you're here to make 
up for, right, Train-o?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's go for one more run! I want 
to engrave that feeling into my body while 
it's fresh.
